title: Center for Reducing Asthma Disparities - Rhode Island/Puerto Rico Centers
brief_summary: To reduce disparities in asthma among Latino children.
raw_criteria: 1\) Diagnosed asthma or history of breathing problems (coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath) in the 12 months prior to study enrollment; 2) Non-Latino white, Puerto Rican or Dominican ethnic background; 3)ages 7-15 years
study_population: Children with asthma or a history of breathing problems, from Non-Latino white, Puerto Rican or Dominican ethnicities. Participant recruitment occurred in Rhode Island and in island Puerto Rico.
